title: ArsenalWeapons
description: New weapons that lets you do alot of cool things
body:
A mod that adds a new weapons

Amethyst sword: does 6.2 attack damage
CopperMace: *right click* strikes lighting on mobs in a 10 block radius (has cooldown)
AmariteSword: deals 8.5 attack damage Ability*right click* dashes forward (has Cooldown)
Scythe: Deals 7.5 damage and makes armour weaker by applying a new effect called vulnerability
Laser gun: fires laser particles that deals damage (has cooldown)
VoidBreaker pickaxe: mines in a 3x3 and very fast
